insights: The design system uses CSS custom properties extensively (--ink, --bg-1, --line-strong, --mts-yellow) enabling seamless light/dark theme switching via the toggle button
Navigation employs a clean underline tab pattern with monospace uppercase text, creating a technical/editorial aesthetic that matches the 'Chronicling the singularity' tech-forward brand
Motion design is primarily JS-driven (Lenis scroll, canvas animations, scroll-triggered reveals) rather than CSS @keyframes, suggesting a React/GSAP stack for complex choreographed interactions
